title: rollcall algorithm catalogue (rollcall-algorithms/1)
description: The export contract of crates/rollcall-assay/db/algorithms.yaml: the file rollcall loads and cbom-infra copies. Validate the YAML parsed as JSON. Structural rules a schema cannot express (names in order and unique ignoring case, the risk class agreeing with the NIST levels, padding only on signature or pke primitives, crypto_functions in order) are rollcall's lint; see docs/catalogue.md.

name.description: The lookup key, unique ignoring ASCII case. One entry per family, primitive and mode or padding, e.g. AES-GCM.

family.description: The algorithm family, e.g. AES, RSA, SHA2.

padding.description: The padding scheme. pkcs1v15 and oaep are CycloneDX 1.6 words; pss is written to CycloneDX as other.

crypto_functions.description: CycloneDX 1.6 algorithmProperties.cryptoFunctions, in ASCII order, without duplicates.

quantum_risk.description: shor-broken: a quantum computer running Shor's algorithm breaks it. grover-weakened: Grover's (or a collision) search weakens it, a larger key or digest restores it. pq-safe: designed to resist a quantum computer.

standards.description: The documents that specify the algorithm, e.g. FIPS 197.

id.description: CycloneDX 1.6 algorithmProperties.parameterSetIdentifier, unique within the entry. Always a string.

nist_quantum_security_level.description: CycloneDX 1.6 algorithmProperties.nistQuantumSecurityLevel: the NIST post-quantum security category, 0 for none.

curve.description: The elliptic curve, named as https://neuromancer.sk/std/ names it.

source.description: Where the two levels come from, in words. Not normative: the sync check ignores it.
